quotes.text: Here's the big philosophical difference. Cloud flows automate labor. Agent flows automate decision making. A Cloud flow might move files from SharePoint to OneDrive.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Draws the core distinction between the two automation types in a few words.

quotes.text: Use agent flows when trigger, logic, or execution depends on conversation, interpretation, or AI cognition. Use cloud flows when coordination, repetition, and visibility across users matter more than intelligence.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a clear decision rule for choosing between cloud flows and agent flows.

quotes.text: However, and here is the design choice Microsoft enforces that conversion is irreversible. Once it drinks the agent flow potion, it stays an agent flow.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Warns that converting a cloud flow to an agent flow cannot be undone.

quotes.text: Many enterprises now pay twice, once for power automate premium to run cloud flows and again for copilot studio capacity that could have run the same automations message-based.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Points to a concrete licensing duplication organizations can remove.

quotes.text: Agent flows don't ask you to abandon power automate. They ask you to evolve it. Build the infrastructure where AI already resides.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames agent flows as an evolution of Power Automate rather than a replacement.

chapters.title: The hidden costs of cloud flows
Choosing between cloud and agent flows

takeaways: Cloud flows are licensed per user or per flow, so premium connectors, API throttling and separate AI Builder credits quickly inflate their cost.
Agent flows in Copilot Studio are billed by message consumption, include premium connectors and AI Builder capabilities, and scale cost linearly with actual usage.
Use agent flows for conversational, AI-driven automation and keep cloud flows for shared, high-volume orchestration; converting a flow to an agent flow is irreversible.
hook: Every new automated cloud flow may be quietly inflating your Power Platform licensing, API quotas and AI Builder costs. This episode is for makers, admins and budget owners deciding where their automations should run. You will learn how agent flows in Copilot Studio change the cost model, when cloud flows still win, and how to migrate without paying twice.
